title: Missed Opportunities: Lehetett volna & Megtehettem volna

sections.title: What Could Have Been Done
sections.content: You know *kellett volna* from B1 Unit 39 and the ending -hat/-het from A2 Unit 23; *lehetett volna* is new here and works like *kellett volna*. To say that a chance in the past was not used ('could have done / it could have been'), Hungarian pairs a verb in -hat/-het with *volna*: *lehetett volna* (it could have been), *megtehettem volna* (I could have done it), *segíthettünk volna* (we could have helped).

items.spanish: Sokkal szebb is lehetett volna az utazás, ha jobb lett volna az idő.
items.english: The journey could have been much nicer if the weather had been better.

items.spanish: Megtehettem volna, hogy elhallgatom az igazságot, de nem akartam hazudni.
items.english: I could have concealed the truth, but I didn't want to lie.

items.spanish: Elkerülhettük volna a félreértést egyetlen telefonhívással.
items.english: We could have avoided the misunderstanding with a single phone call.
